entry.en: Your passport must be undamaged and valid for the duration of your stay in Kosovo.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe estar sin daños y ser válido durante toda tu estancia en Kosovo.
entry.quote: To enter Kosovo, your passport must be undamaged and valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: Officials may ask for documentary evidence of the reason for your stay or of sufficient finances.
entry.es: Los funcionarios pueden pedir pruebas documentales del motivo de tu estancia o de que tienes fondos suficientes.
entry.quote: Officials may ask you to provide documentary evidence giving a reason for your stay or showing you have sufficient finances.

entry.en: You cannot travel from Kosovo to Serbia without a Serbian entry stamp from an airport such as Belgrade, Niš or Kraljevo or another Serbian border crossing.
entry.es: No puedes viajar de Kosovo a Serbia sin un sello de entrada serbio de los aeropuertos de Belgrado, Niš o Kraljevo, o de otro paso fronterizo serbio.
entry.quote: You cannot travel from Kosovo to Serbia without a Serbian entry stamp from Belgrade, Niš or Kraljevo airports, or one of Serbia’s other border crossings with:

entry.en: Border guards have denied foreign nationals entry to Serbia if their passports have Republic of Kosovo stamps.
entry.es: Los guardias fronterizos han negado la entrada a Serbia a extranjeros con sellos de la República de Kosovo en el pasaporte.
entry.quote: Border guards have denied foreign nationals entry to Serbia if they have Republic of Kosovo stamps in their passports.

entry.en: There are strict rules on goods taken into or out of Kosovo, and you must declare anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay normas estrictas sobre los bienes que se pueden llevar a Kosovo o sacar de él, y debes declarar lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Kosovo. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Pickpockets operate in airports and on public transport.
safety.es: Los carteristas operan en aeropuertos y en el transporte público.
safety.quote: Pickpockets operate in airports and on public transport.

safety.en: The situation is generally stable, but there is a risk of protests in the northern municipalities and in northern Mitrovica.
safety.es: La situación es en general estable, pero hay riesgo de protestas en los municipios del norte y en el norte de Mitrovica.
safety.quote: The political situation is generally stable, but there is a risk of protests in the northern municipalities of Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Leposavic, and areas of Mitrovica north of the river Ibar.

safety.en: Residual landmines and unexploded bombs and weapons remain in Kosovo from the 1999 conflict.
safety.es: Quedan minas terrestres y bombas y armas sin explotar en Kosovo del conflicto de 1999.
safety.quote: Residual landmines and other unexploded bombs and weapons remain in Kosovo from the 1999 conflict.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Kosovo cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Kosovo.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Kosovo cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Use ATMs inside banks if possible and check street ATMs for signs of tampering.
safety.es: Usa cajeros dentro de bancos si es posible y revisa los cajeros de la calle por si han sido manipulados.
safety.quote: Use ATMs inside banks if possible, and check ATMs on the street for signs of tampering.

safety.en: Manhole covers are often missing due to theft, posing a serious safety risk.
safety.es: A menudo faltan tapas de alcantarilla por robos, lo que supone un grave riesgo.
safety.quote: Manhole covers are often missing due to theft, posing a serious safety risk.

health.en: Crimean Congo Haemorrhagic Fever is endemic in Kosovo.
health.es: La fiebre hemorrágica de Crimea-Congo es endémica en Kosovo.
health.quote: Crimean Congo Haemorrhagic Fever is endemic in Kosovo.

health.en: Mosquito-borne diseases are present in Kosovo, including West Nile virus.
health.es: Hay enfermedades transmitidas por mosquitos en Kosovo, incluido el virus del Nilo Occidental.
health.quote: Mosquito-borne diseases are present, including West Nile virus.

health.en: Kosovo's public health system is poorly funded, with hospitals lacking specialist equipment and widespread shortages of medicines.
health.es: El sistema de salud público de Kosovo tiene poca financiación, con hospitales sin equipo especializado y escasez generalizada de medicamentos.
health.quote: The public health system in Kosovo is poorly funded. Hospitals lack specialist equipment and there is a widespread shortage of medicines and other essentials.

health.en: High levels of air pollution can occur in Kosovo, particularly in Pristina.
health.es: En Kosovo puede haber altos niveles de contaminación del aire, en particular en Pristina.
health.quote: High levels of air pollution can occur in Kosovo, particularly in Pristina.

health.en: Tap water in cities is safe and drinkable.
health.es: El agua del grifo en las ciudades es segura y potable.
health.quote: Tap water in cities is safe and drinkable.

health.en: Kosovo has no public health insurance system, so medical expenses must be paid in cash at the time of service.
health.es: Kosovo no tiene un sistema público de seguro médico, por lo que los gastos médicos se pagan en efectivo en el momento del servicio.
health.quote: Kosovo does not have a public health insurance system, which means that all medical expenses must be paid in cash at the time of service.

help.en: The number for all emergencies in Kosovo is 112.
help.es: El número para todas las emergencias en Kosovo es el 112.

help.en: For an ambulance, dial 94 from a landline or 194 from a mobile.
help.es: Para una ambulancia, marca el 94 desde un teléfono fijo o el 194 desde un móvil.
help.quote: Dial 94 from a landline or 194 from a mobile and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: Pristina International Airport (PRN) receives direct flights from several European airlines.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Pristina (PRN) recibe vuelos directos de varias aerolíneas europeas.
getting_in.quote: Pristina International Airport (PRN IATA). Several European airlines offer direct flights from their hubs to the Pristina International Airport

getting_in.en: The most used route into Kosovo is through North Macedonia and Pristina Airport.
getting_in.es: La ruta más usada para entrar a Kosovo es a través de Macedonia del Norte y el aeropuerto de Pristina.
getting_in.quote: The most used transport route is through North Macedonia and Pristina Airport.

getting_in.en: From Skopje in North Macedonia you can take a bus to Pristina in less than 1½ hours.
getting_in.es: Desde Skopje, en Macedonia del Norte, puedes tomar un autobús a Pristina en menos de 1 hora y media.
getting_in.quote: From North Macedonia (Skopje), you can take a bus to Pristina (less than 1½ hr).

getting_in.en: From Montenegro the only legal border crossing is at Rozhaja.
getting_in.es: Desde Montenegro, el único paso fronterizo legal es Rozhaja.
getting_in.quote: From Montenegro, the only legal border crossing is at Rozhaja.

getting_in.en: From Albania you can cross at Morine or at Qafa e Prushit near Gjakova.
getting_in.es: Desde Albania puedes cruzar por Morine o por Qafa e Prushit, cerca de Gjakova.
getting_in.quote: From Albania you can cross at Morine or at Qafa e Prushit near Gjakova.

getting_in.en: International Motor Insurance Cards are not accepted, so you need to pay for separate insurance at the border.
getting_in.es: No se aceptan las tarjetas internacionales de seguro de automóvil, por lo que debes pagar un seguro aparte en la frontera.
getting_in.quote: International Motor Insurance Cards are not accepted. At the border you will need to pay for separate insurance

getting_around.en: The best way to travel between cities in Kosovo is by bus.
getting_around.es: La mejor forma de viajar entre ciudades en Kosovo es en autobús.
getting_around.quote: The best way to travel intercity in Kosovo is by bus.

getting_around.en: As of May 2026, the only train connections are two daily trains from Pristina to Peja, costing €3.
getting_around.es: A mayo de 2026, las únicas conexiones de tren son dos trenes diarios de Pristina a Peja, que cuestan 3 €.
getting_around.quote: The only connections as of May 2026 are two daily trains from Pristina to Peja which are a comfortable way to make this journey (€3).

getting_around.en: It is best to use registered taxis, which have fixed prices and are metered.
getting_around.es: Es mejor usar taxis registrados, que tienen precios fijos y taxímetro.
getting_around.quote: It is best to use registered taxis as they have fixed prices and are metered.

getting_around.en: International ride-hailing apps are not available in Kosovo.
getting_around.es: Las aplicaciones internacionales de transporte no están disponibles en Kosovo.
getting_around.quote: International ride-hailing apps are not available.

getting_around.en: Between some cities minivans run from near the main bus station.
getting_around.es: Entre algunas ciudades hay minibuses que salen cerca de la estación principal de autobuses.
getting_around.quote: Between some cities you may also have the option of minivans, running from nearby the main bus station.

getting_around.en: Driving in Kosovo requires a locally valid insurance policy, as European green card insurance is not valid.
getting_around.es: Para conducir en Kosovo se necesita un seguro válido localmente, ya que el seguro europeo de carta verde no es válido.
getting_around.quote: You will need a locally valid insurance policy. European green card vehicle insurance is not valid.

money.quote: Kosovo uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted, but keep cash just in case.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito son ampliamente aceptadas, pero lleva efectivo por si acaso.
money.quote: Credit/debit cards are  widely accepted, but keep cash just in case

money.en: Money exchange is available in most cities and larger towns.
money.es: Hay cambio de moneda en la mayoría de ciudades y pueblos grandes.
money.quote: Money exchange is available in most cities and larger towns.

money.en: The Serbian dinar is used in the Serbian-majority municipalities in Kosovo.
money.es: El dinar serbio se usa en los municipios de mayoría serbia de Kosovo.
money.quote: The Serbian dinar is used in the Serbian-majority municipalities in Kosovo.

money.en: Tipping is generally not expected from locals in Kosovo, but it is welcome from foreigners.
money.es: Generalmente no se espera propina de los locales en Kosovo, pero se agradece de los extranjeros.
money.quote: In Kosovo generally tipping is not expected from locals, but as it is done by foreigners, it is welcome.

connectivity.en: A local SIM costs €3 from major carriers Vala and Ipko, and you must register with ID.
connectivity.es: Una SIM local cuesta 3 € en los operadores Vala e Ipko, y debes registrarte con identificación.
connectivity.quote: You can buy a local SIM card for €3, with the two major carriers being Vala and Ipko. You must provide an ID (passport) and register.

connectivity.en: Many Balkan mobile providers offer free roaming across Balkan countries.
connectivity.es: Muchos operadores móviles de los Balcanes ofrecen roaming gratuito entre países balcánicos.
connectivity.quote: Many mobile providers in the Balkans provide free roaming across Balkan countries.

connectivity.en: Most bars, cafes and restaurants have free Wi-Fi for customers.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de bares, cafés y restaurantes tienen wifi gratis para clientes.
connectivity.quote: Most bars, cafes and restaurants have free Wi-Fi connection that customers can use.
